title.en: Helpful veterinary team with mixed reviews

text.en: Most long-term clients commend the clinic team and vets like Eilidh for compassionate, supportive care during difficult moments and last-minute visits. However, two recent reviewers voiced strong dissatisfaction, citing irresponsible clinical judgment and questioning staff empathy.

Several clients praise the practice for patiently answering medical questions and managing direct insurance claims smoothly. In contrast, a critical reviewer reported confusing communication regarding treatment alternatives and felt unaddressed before receiving reception bills.

Reviewers note tender and gentle handling for pets during routine cat check-ups and dignified end-of-life care for small animals. Conversely, one pet owner raised concerns about an unneeded surgical recommendation that carried unnecessary anesthesia risks for a small pet.

q.en: Can clients arrange same-day veterinary appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients mention securing same-day appointments and early evening consultations after working hours.

q.en: Does the reception team process insurance claims?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that reception staff handled both direct and indirect pet insurance claims smoothly.

q.en: Are pricing and procedure options explained clearly?

a.en: Experiences vary; some clients report clear answers, while others felt fee estimates and alternatives were not explained upfront.

q.en: Does the clinic treat small pets and exotic mammals?

a.en: Yes, reviews describe compassionate care and end-of-life support for small pets including degus.
